methodologyNote: Measured via page views of macOS desktop traffic.
metricLabel: market share of tracked page views / usage
aiSummary: In October 2026, macOS Catalina led macos versions (desktop) in United Kingdom at 84.83% (market share of tracked page views / usage). macOS 19 ranked second at 2.2%, followed by macOS 15.7 at 2.04%.

faqs.question: Which item leads macos versions (desktop) in United Kingdom?
faqs.answer: macOS Catalina leads at 84.83% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/macos-version-market-share/desktop/united-kingdom.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for macos versions (desktop) in United Kingdom?
faqs.answer: macOS Catalina (84.83%), macOS 19 (2.2%), macOS 15.7 (2.04%) in October 2026.
